family_rule: First registered development family, both reconstructions, all six targets and every source subset. M2 two/all counted once for totals; published alias retained.
scores: Original recorded producer score grids vs independent Mac CPU end-to-end native inference with the same model metadata, exact weights, case assets, and single frozen threshold.
scope: Every native deployment pixel including pixels without scientific evaluation labels; no real labels or threshold fitting enters the runtime comparison.
exact: Compare finite support mask, rational low/high/unknown decisions computed with float64 comparison of float32 score against the stored threshold, and bit patterns on common finite floats. Report all three separately.
bounded: Support difference must be exactly zero and at least one common finite value in every successful real view. Absolute score difference <= 0.0001 on all common finite pixels. A changed decision is recorded even when the bounded numerical check passes.
threshold_crossings: Publish per view low-to-high, high-to-low and all state changes including changes involving unknown. For each side report finite pixels within 1e-6,1e-5,1e-4 absolute score of its frozen threshold; show maximum distance of any crossing from that same threshold. No readjustment.
summaries: Report maximum absolute error, mean absolute error, 50th/95th/99th absolute percentiles, maximum nonnegative float32 ULP distance and exact-bit count; one paired comparison per method, reconstruction, target and nonredundant subset. Missing views remain explicit with a null numerical assessment.
